conditions.says_en: More than one way is in use, or none yet, and not all have come to one.
conditions.says_zh: 不止一种做法在用，或者还没有哪一种，还没有都归到同一个上。
conditions.why: English true to the anchors (as the negation of agreement) and kept. Chinese: wording only, 大家 is a word for persons.

conditions.says_en: What it does is passed on down the line and no chain of effects leads back to it.
conditions.says_zh: 它做的只往下游传，没有哪条因果的链子绕回它自己。

conditions.says_en: A chain of effects leads back to where it started, so a difference can go round.
conditions.says_zh: 有一条因果的链子绕回起点，于是一点差别可以转着圈走。

conditions.says_en: A departure is answered by a push back no larger than the gap. The gap closes and stays closed.
conditions.says_zh: 偏离了，就有一个不超过缺口的回推。缺口合上，并且保持合上。

conditions.says_en: Nothing it could stay at meets what it is after: the mark is set against where it now is, or two or more are each after standing above all the rest.
conditions.says_zh: 它停在哪里都达不到它要的：那个标准是对着它现在的位置定的；或者两个以上各自都要压过其余所有的。
conditions.why: A mark above all others can be met at rest by one alone; the law is that no state at rest meets it for each of two.

conditions.says_en: From some point on nothing about it changes. It is still there, unlike what has ended.
conditions.says_zh: 从某一刻起，它什么都不再变。它还在，这一点和“尽了”不同。

conditions.says_en: It keeps changing and keeps arriving back where it was. Where nothing is lost on the way, nothing stops it.
conditions.says_zh: 它一直在变，又一直回到原来的地方。路上什么都不损耗，就没有什么让它停下。

conditions.says_en: Each correction goes too far or comes too late, so the mark is passed from both sides again and again.
conditions.says_zh: 每次纠正不是过了头，就是来得太晚，于是一次次从两边越过那个点。

missing.en: Where only what goes on can give, and going on needs every need met: once none of a group has what it needs, none has it again while no need loosens and nothing outside gives to what it needs.
missing.zh: 只有还在延续的才给得出、延续又要每样需要都满足的地方：一群里一旦哪个都不够用，只要需要不放松、群外也没有往它们要用的东西里补，就再没有哪个够用。
missing.why: A way back, and what it needs: the end absorbs unless a need loosens or something beyond gives. Built cases show each working (Restoring.Inflow, Restoring.Adapting), and three more show the other premises are needed.

missing.en: Where each can do without as many of those it waits on as have lapsed, all give next step. Where each gives once those it waits on gave, and chains of waits are bounded, all give after that many steps.
missing.zh: 各自都能少等几个、少的不比断掉的少时，下一步全都照给。各自只要所等的都给了就给、而一串串的“等”有个最长的长度时，过了那么多步全都照给。
missing.why: A way back the course itself makes; d1.round's own gloss says it and no passage carries it. On a loop of waits it fails: the lapse comes back every turn (Withholding.withholding_returns).

missing.en: Where each gives only if it gave before and all it waits on gave, one lapse stops every one it can reach along the waits, within as many steps as the chain is long, and none gives again.
missing.zh: 各自都要自己上一步给过、所等的也都给了才给的地方：有一个不给，顺着“等”够得着的全都跟着停，停下所需的步数不超过那串“等”的长度，而且都不再给。
missing.why: The closing law of this row, absent from the four sets I could see; it is the other side of the passage above.

missing.en: In a built case where what is removed was renewing what the selecting one lives on, the course that removes it ends the selecting one too; measured among what is left, even this shows nothing missing.
missing.zh: 一个造出来的例子：被清走的那一方，原本在补着做选择的一方所靠的东西；清走它的那条进程，把做选择的也带到尽头；只在剩下的里面衡量，连这一点也看不出少了什么。
missing.why: What the Lean shows where the passage from b3.gone to b2.felt only reads: the loss returns as an ending, unregistered.

missing.en: Where the links still acting from some step on form no ring upstream, the most difference that can arrive grows only like a power of the steps, whatever came before: a ring counts only while its links go on acting.
missing.zh: 从某一步起，还在起作用的环节在上游合不成圈：那么能传到的差别，最多只按步数的若干次方涨，不管此前如何。圈只在它的环节还在起作用时才算数。
missing.why: The way out of a ring: its couplings stopping. The premise is that they stop; no law here says when they do.

missing.en: In the market model, a floor is kept at the next step from every level at or above it, under every influence within its bound, exactly where what correction returns at the floor covers the most that influence erodes there.
missing.zh: 在市场模型里：从底线以上的任何水平出发、在影响不超过上限的任何情形下，下一步都守得住底线，恰在底线处纠正补回来的抵得上影响最多能蚀掉的时候。
missing.why: Split from the passage of the same ends: an exact threshold in another model, periphery (namespace RegimeBoundary, not Becoming; rational states). A negative margin gives a region below the floor, not entry into it.

groups.notes: Of the 16 drawn as 'law', 7 stay, 6 become 'needs' and 3 'line'; two passages are moved. Every way back or out in the set needs something from beyond the course or the group (another rule, a giver, a form from outside or newly made, a third value) or is by chance; the exceptions are a lapse passing out and a ring's links stopping (missing). d1.gap has no passage in the four sets I could see. Becoming.gap_polynomial_iff_no_loop is a line between e1.line and e1.ring. RegimeBoundary and SeededContinuation are periphery, outside namespace Becoming. Web.consumed_continues_transformed also carries a2.short→a2.else in the stock set. Row names b0 and b3 in Chinese use 谁.
